bm25.note: the production BM25: word tokens, character trigrams for CJK queries

hybrid.note: reciprocal rank fusion (k = 60) of bm25 and dense

bm25_words.note: word tokens only; reported for the Japanese comparison, never selectable

unsure_semantics: fixed ranks: unsure keeps its position, counts as neither relevant nor not relevant. Supersedes the condensed-list note in gold_relevance_v1.json and decision 0014.

metrics.hit@k: 1 if any relevant item at rank <= k
metrics.recall@k: relevant at rank <= k / all relevant in frozen gold
metrics.mrr: 1 / rank of first relevant item, 0 if none
metrics.unsure@k: unsure at rank <= k / items retrieved at rank <= k
metrics.recall_denominator_questions: DEV questions with >= 1 item judged relevant; others reported separately

eligibility.latency_protocol: one untimed warm-up query per candidate, then each DEV question timed once, in DEV question order, wall-clock around retrieval only
integrity: every retrieved item satisfies the question's filters
no retrieved item breaks the temporal cutoff (published_at, and first_seen_at in replay mode)
no duplicate item in a ranking

primary_metric: macro Recall@10 on DEV questions with >= 1 resolved relevant item

clear_winner.method: paired by question; resample questions with replacement; mean difference; percentile interval
clear_winner.condition: the candidate's Recall@10 difference against every other eligible candidate has a 95% CI lower bound > 0

order: keep eligible candidates within 0.03 of the best macro Recall@10
among them, keep those within 0.03 of the best Hit@10

subgroup_safeguard.condition: HARD_STOP if the selected candidate has Hit@10 = 0 on a subgroup with >= 3 gold-answerable DEV questions while another eligible candidate has Hit@10 > 0 there
subgroup_safeguard.subgroups: english, non_english, temporal, not_temporal, answerable_expected, unanswerable_expected, gold_answerable, each query_type, filtered_sector_or_source
